svg.title: oh-my-openchamber v2 — Architecture
svg.desc: One score, one conductor, seven chairs. The WorkOrder is the single canonical artifact; the Conductor is its only writer; no state transition without evidence. Execution is a continuation of the same conductor in a new goal-armed session — no second conductor, no handover. Native OpenChamber mechanics act as adapters.
svg.text: One score, one conductor, seven chairs — the domain model riding OpenChamber’s native machine.

g.text: CONDUCTOR — sole writer of the work order
ONLY WRITER of the work order
ROUTE — WRITTEN TO ORDER + ROUTING MEMORY
